newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shares end 0.6 pct down in weak turnover.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shares end 0.6 pct down in weak turnover.

text.p: Brazil shares ended down 0.6 percent in lackluster and thin trade with investors rolling over positions, brokers said.
"There is no news and no fresh money coming in," said a broker, noting trading would continue to be weak on Thursday due to the Thanksgiving Day holiday in the United States.
The Bovespa index of the 49 most traded shares ended down 396 points at 65,919 points. Turnover was 290.4 million reais ($281.4 million).
